verdict.rationale: Stripe Billing can run headlessly. Subscriptions are created through the Subscriptions API rather than the Dashboard, usage is reported via the Meter Events API, and state changes reach automation through webhooks. An official CLI is documented to build, test, and manage the integration from the command line. However, the evidence never explicitly addresses CI pipelines, non-interactive authentication, or sandbox/test-mode use in automated runs. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD usage documentation (non-interactive CLI auth, test-mode automation guidance), independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
